summary: Crystal Caverns is a vast geode network within the Plane of Earth. Resonant crystal formations, mineral bridges, and pressure-grown chambers create a labyrinth of shimmering elemental stone.
history: Formed when primordial pressure fractured the mountain-heart into geode chambers.
Crystal resonance grew over millennia, shaping pathways and caverns.
Mineral guardians emerged from the deepest crystal fields.
The Crystal Sovereign arose as the ruler of the resonant core.
